question: What are the opening hours of Nimbus City Library?
answer: Nimbus City Library is open Monday to Saturday from 8 AM to 8 PM, and on Sunday from 10 AM to 4 PM.

question: Is the library open on public holidays?
answer: No. The library is closed on national public holidays, but the online catalogue and e-book service stay available.

question: How do I get a library card?
answer: Bring one photo ID and one proof of address to the front desk. The card is issued on the spot and is free for city residents.

question: Is the library card free?
answer: Yes, the card is free for Nimbus City residents. Non-residents pay 300 rupees per year.

question: How much does a library card cost for non-residents?
answer: The annual card fee for non-residents is 300 rupees.

question: How many books can I borrow at a time?
answer: Adult members can borrow up to 6 items at a time. Junior members can borrow up to 4 items.

question: How long can I keep a borrowed book?
answer: The loan period for books is 21 days. DVDs and magazines have a loan period of 7 days.

question: What is the loan period for DVDs?
answer: DVDs can be borrowed for 7 days.

question: Can I renew a book?
answer: Yes. Each item can be renewed twice, online or at the desk, as long as no other member has reserved it.

question: How many times can I renew an item?
answer: An item can be renewed a maximum of two times.

question: What is the late fee for overdue books?
answer: The late fee is 2 rupees per day for each book, up to a maximum of 100 rupees per book.

question: What is the maximum fine for one overdue book?
answer: The fine for one overdue book stops at 100 rupees.

question: What is the late fee for overdue DVDs?
answer: Overdue DVDs are charged 10 rupees per day.

question: What happens if I lose a book?
answer: You pay the replacement cost of the book plus a 50 rupee processing fee. If you find the book within 30 days, the replacement cost is refunded.

question: Can I reserve a book that is already borrowed?
answer: Yes. You can place a hold online or at the desk. You will get an SMS when the book is ready, and it is kept for you for 5 days.

question: How long is a reserved book kept for me?
answer: A reserved book is kept at the holds shelf for 5 days after you are notified.

question: Is there Wi-Fi in the library?
answer: Yes. Free Wi-Fi is available. The network name is NimbusLib-Guest and you log in with your library card number.

question: What is the Wi-Fi network name?
answer: The guest Wi-Fi network is called NimbusLib-Guest.

question: How do I log in to the library Wi-Fi?
answer: Connect to NimbusLib-Guest and enter your library card number on the login page.

question: Can I use the computers in the library?
answer: Yes. Members can book a computer for up to 2 hours per day. Bookings are made at the front desk or on the library website.

question: How long can I use a library computer each day?
answer: Each member can use a library computer for up to 2 hours per day.

question: How much does printing cost?
answer: Black-and-white printing costs 3 rupees per page and colour printing costs 10 rupees per page.

question: How much is colour printing?
answer: Colour printing costs 10 rupees per page.

question: Does the library have study rooms?
answer: Yes. There are 8 group study rooms on the second floor. They can be booked for up to 3 hours at a time.

question: How do I book a study room?
answer: Book a study room on the library website or at the front desk, up to 7 days in advance.

question: How far in advance can I book a study room?
answer: Study rooms can be booked up to 7 days in advance.

question: Where are the study rooms?
answer: The group study rooms are on the second floor.

question: Is food allowed in the library?
answer: Snacks and covered drinks are allowed in the cafe area on the ground floor only. Food is not allowed in the reading halls.

question: Where is the cafe?
answer: The cafe is on the ground floor near the main entrance.

question: Does the library have e-books?
answer: Yes. Members can borrow e-books and audiobooks through the NimbusReads app, using their card number and PIN.

question: What is the name of the e-book app?
answer: The library's e-book and audiobook app is called NimbusReads.

question: How many e-books can I borrow at once?
answer: You can borrow up to 5 e-books or audiobooks at a time on NimbusReads.

question: I forgot my PIN. What should I do?
answer: Use the Forgot PIN link on the library website, or visit the front desk with your photo ID to reset it.

question: Does the library have a children's section?
answer: Yes. The children's section is on the first floor and has a story-time session every Saturday at 11 AM.

question: When is story time for children?
answer: Story time is held every Saturday at 11 AM in the children's section on the first floor.

question: At what age can a child get a library card?
answer: Children of any age can get a junior card. A parent or guardian must sign the application for children under 12.

question: Can I donate books to the library?
answer: Yes. Donations of books in good condition, published in the last 10 years, are accepted at the front desk on weekdays.

question: Is there parking at the library?
answer: Yes. There is free parking for 40 cars and 100 two-wheelers behind the building, for up to 3 hours.

question: How long can I park at the library?
answer: Parking is free for up to 3 hours.

question: Is the library wheelchair accessible?
answer: Yes. The building has a ramp at the main entrance, a lift to all floors, and an accessible washroom on every floor.

question: Does the library have a lift?
answer: Yes. A lift serves all floors of the building.

question: How do I contact the library?
answer: Call 0891-2345678, email help@nimbuslib.example, or visit the front desk.

question: What is the library's phone number?
answer: The library's phone number is 0891-2345678.

question: What is the library's email address?
answer: You can email the library at help@nimbuslib.example.

question: Can I return books when the library is closed?
answer: Yes. Use the 24-hour book drop box next to the main entrance. Items are checked in the next working day.

question: Where is the book drop box?
answer: The 24-hour book drop box is next to the main entrance.

question: Does the library offer photocopying?
answer: Yes. Photocopying costs 2 rupees per page and is available at the copy centre on the ground floor.

question: Can I suggest a book for the library to buy?
answer: Yes. Fill in the Suggest a Purchase form on the library website. The library replies within 14 days.

question: How quickly does the library respond to a purchase suggestion?
answer: The library replies to a purchase suggestion within 14 days.

question: Are there any free events for adults?
answer: Yes. There is a free book club on the first Friday of every month at 6 PM, and a weekly computer skills class on Wednesdays at 3 PM.

question: When does the book club meet?
answer: The book club meets on the first Friday of every month at 6 PM.

question: When is the computer skills class?
answer: The free computer skills class is held every Wednesday at 3 PM.
